overview.text: Claw402 presents a wallet-paid gateway for models, market data and analytics. Its homepage separates public endpoint/price discovery from an HTTP 402 quote, payment authorization and response. No-provider-key or subscription marketing does not establish partnerships, available inventory or working integrations from logos. Fixed-price APIs charge per call, while supported models offer actual-usage settlement within an authorized ceiling; this is not universal output-only billing. Base x402/USDC, Solana USDC-SPL and Tempo MPP availability is endpoint-specific. Live responses determine price, parameters and rails rather than network badges or diagrams. Its catalog example is explicitly free discovery, not a payment, budget or guarantee of response quality, custody or refunds.
